detail.longDescription: When I got married, my mom and I visited countless bakeries looking for the perfect wedding cake. Nothing quite hit the mark. So she did what any completely rational mother of the bride would do: she made the cake herself. It ended up being perfectly customized to our specifications (raspberry dark chocolate with buttercream frosting)—but it also added more than a few gray hairs and kept her up until 2 a.m. the night before, hand-perfecting the icing. n8n's pricing works a lot like that decision
